meta.selection_rule: every token launched on the Pons V2 bonding curve factory inside a fixed 1 hour window on Robinhood Chain, requiring at least 20 transfers and a peak of 10 holders; no survivorship or liveness filter
meta.epoch_note: epochs are 1 hour, which is 35,363 blocks at the chain's ~0.1 s block time; the 37 epoch run covers ~1.31M blocks per token
meta.venue_note: Robinhood Chain launches are Pons V2 curves quoted in USDG, not Uniswap V2 WETH pairs, so the cohort rule targets that factory
